node_executions.notes: Add a Scout / Veto / Brief agent layer between TradingAdvisor.recommend_entry and PortfolioManager.open_position. Explicit constraints: agents never call the broker, hold keys, change live gates, or bypass circuit breaker / PDT / correlation / sizer; no crypto, memecoin, Robinhood, DEX, quantum_predictor, or crypto_trading usage; LLM off by default.

Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GRAPH.md, EVIDENCE.md, prior evidence bundles, main.py (_tick, _open_position_if_running, _log_decision, _record_rejection, _update_dashboard), advisor.py, models/domain.py, decision_log.py, settings.py, config.yaml, dashboard/state.py + app.py, broker_base.py, circuit_breaker status, position_sizer PDT logic, helpers is_market_open/is_near_close, regime enum, alpha filter pattern, existing test construction of TradingBot.

VetoContext is a frozen dataclass projection so RuleVeto stays pure. AgentGate builds context from tick objects, short-circuits scout on veto block, applies require_scout/block_toxic_catalysts policy, multiplies veto * (0.5 if advisor reduce), briefs. Fail-closed on unexpected exception. agents.enabled=false is a no-op allow that records nothing. Scout reads provider keys from env at call time; SDKs are lazy optional extras; a Protocol client is injected for tests. Brief persists to data/agent_decisions.csv (decision_log.csv keeps its one-row-per-candidate invariant via the existing _log_decision path).

New package trading_bot/agents (models, veto, scout, brief, gate). Typed AgentsConfig/AgentLLMConfig/AgentVetoConfig in settings.py with bounds and a provider/model mismatch validator; agents: block in config.yaml. main.py: AgentGate.from_config constructed beside TradingAdvisor; gate evaluated in _tick immediately after recommend_entry for every advisor outcome; block -> RejectedSignal(stage=agent_veto, reason prefixed [agent_veto]) + decision_log skip row; reduce -> in-place risk_result.shares shrink via the same hook regime/tier/volatility use; allow -> unchanged path; agent_decisions pushed to DashboardState; agent_veto added to daily-summary stage list. Dashboard: agent_decisions snapshot field, agent_decisions_count in /api/status, new /api/agent-decisions. Optional extra [llm] in pyproject. README, .env.example, CLAUDE.md module table updated. _assert_live_evidence_gate, circuit order, Alpaca key handling, live confirmation copy, crypto and quantum modules untouched.

79 new tests in tests/agents: veto (31), scout (20), gate (28 incl. 7 TradingBot._tick wiring tests on the keyless PaperBroker). First run had 7 test-side failures (recursive now_et patch, fixture lacked _running=True, wrong symbol/tier arithmetic); fixed in the tests, no production change required.

Targeted suites (273) and the complete pre-existing backend suite (2959) pass with the gate wired in. CI web job then failed on a production npm audit of the untouched frontend lockfile (browserslist, fast-uri); the existing Dependabot fix (#82, #83) was ported with npm --package-lock-only and the audit passes locally.
Wrote this execution record and its evidence bundle with SHA-256 file digests and canonical content hashes (sha256 of sort_keys compact JSON excluding content_hash).

Agent-side state is 'tested', not 'verified'. No independent UIE verification exists. The LLM provider clients (OpenAI chat completions, Anthropic messages) are exercised only through the injected fake client; no real model call was made in this run and no provider SDK was installed.
Ready for a draft pull request and human review. No merge, deployment, restart, broker mutation, or live-money action is part of this run.
